name: Linux kernel and LLM inference upskilling

mentions.name: Linux kernel and LLM inference upskilling
mentions.description: A self-directed learning effort to build skills in Linux kernel development and LLM inference systems, aimed at getting past field-specific incidental knowledge to reach the core development loop employers care about.
mentions.problem: These areas are sufficiently foreign that learning time goes mostly to the "accidentals" rather than the core dev loop an employer would care about, making them hard to get into.
mentions.source_excerpt: Upskilling in both linux kernel dev work and also LLM inference systems work.
mentions.author: sigbottle
